Each card below was written from one document, in answer to the same question. Sort the cards into groups.

Question: 371st refers to which type of unit?

Card 1 (from document 1)
  entity: 371st Engineer Construction Battalion
  sense: not stated
  answer: Engineer Construction Battalion
  as of: not stated
  evidence: "371st Engineer Construction Battalion 371st Engineer Construction Battalion or 371st Engineer Battalion was activated as a Special Service Regiment in February 1944, as a unit in the United States Army."
Card 2 (from document 3)
  entity: 371st Engineer Construction Battalion or 371st Engineer Battalion
  sense: not stated
  answer: Engineer
  as of: not stated
  evidence: "371st Engineer Construction Battalion or 371st Engineer Battalion [ 1 ] was activated as a Special Service Regiment in February 1944 , as a unit in the United States Army ."
Card 3 (from document 4)
  entity: 371st Infantry Regiment
  sense: not stated
  answer: 371st Infantry Regiment
  as of: not stated
  evidence: "371st Infantry Regiment"
Card 4 (from document 5)
  entity: 371st Infantry Regiment (United States)
  sense: not stated
  answer: segregated African American regiment
  as of: not stated
  evidence: "371st Infantry Regiment (United States) The 371st Infantry Regiment was a segregated African American regiment,"
Card 5 (from document 6)
  entity: 372nd Infantry Regiment
  sense: not stated
  answer: Infantry
  as of: not stated
  evidence: "372nd Infantry Regiment was organized in January 1918 at Camp Stewart , Virginia and initially assigned to the 93rd Division ( Provisional ) ."
Card 6 (from document 7)
  entity: 371st Infantry Regiment (United States)
  sense: not stated
  answer: Infantry Regiment
  as of: not stated
  evidence: "wikidata :371st Infantry Regiment ( United States ) dbpedia-fr :371st Infantry Regiment ( United States )"
Card 7 (from document 9)
  entity: 371st Bombardment Squadron (Heavy)
  sense: not stated
  answer: Boeing B-47 Stratojet medium jet bomber squadron
  as of: not stated
  evidence: "Constituted as the 371st Bombardment Squadron (Heavy)"
Card 8 (from document 10)
  entity: 371st Bombardment Squadron
  sense: Medium
  answer: B-47
  as of: 1965
  evidence: "371st Bombardment Squadron , Medium Lincoln AFB B-47 Inactivated 1965"

Sort in three layers:
1. Entity. Cards about the same real-world thing go together. A shared name is not enough, because different people, places and works can have the same name: go by the identifying details (what kind of thing, role, place, years, other names). Cards that describe one thing in different words go together. Cards with the same identifying details go together even when their answers differ.
2. Sense. Inside an entity, cards about the same event, edition, version, condition, place or measure go together. Cards whose sense is "not stated" go in a sense named "not stated".
3. Answer. Inside a sense, cards with compatible answers go together: the same answer in other words or at another precision, such as "December 2009" and "18 December 2009". Answers that differ go in separate groups, whichever you believe is right.

Reply with JSON only, in this form, where each list of numbers is one group of cards with compatible answers:
{"entities": [{"name": "", "senses": [{"name": "", "answers": [[1, 2], [3]]}]}], "uncertain": []}

"name" of an entity: its full name with the details that identify it.
"uncertain": the numbers of the cards that could belong to more than one entity.
Every card number appears exactly once under "answers".
